page.running_head: C.4. De præsent. reali corp. Christi.

main_text.head: CAP. IV. De prima controversia circa Eucharistiam cum Lutheranis, quæ est de præsentia reali corporis & sanguinis Christi in, cum, sub pane & vino & orali manducatione corporis Christi.
main_text.p: 1Controversiæ, quæ hodiè circa doctrinam de Eucharistia agitantur, potissimum sunt triplicis generis: Primum cum Lutheranis. Alterum cum Pontificiis. Tertium cum Socinianis & Anabaptistis.

2Cum Lutheranis duæ sunt Controversiæ principales: prior, de præsentia reali corporis & sanguinis Christi in, cum, & sub pane & vino in Eucharistia: in deque consequenti orali manducatione corporis Christi: altera quæ hinc sequitur, de manducatione indignorum. Huic duplici principali adhæret controversia Notionalis, quæ est de ῥήματω verborum Christi, & an sit tropus aliquis in verbis Cœnæ [?]
main_text.notes: Marginal text at right edge is largely cut off and only partly legible; the marginal notes beside the second paragraph are partly illegible. Several words in the margin and on the line "ῥήματω" are doubtful. The Greek word in the second paragraph is rendered as printed as far as it can be read.
